patch_description: Crossover of the two top lineages: the staged coarse-to-fine pipeline (champion, 0.64 — noise estimator → capped-Q adaptive Kalman → robust widened SG → recency convolution → local hysteresis snap → zero-phase SG polish) crossed with the first program's structural mutation: bidirectional Kalman fusion. The capped-Q adaptive Kalman is now run both forward and on the time-reversed signal and fused 50/50; the backward pass's phase error opposes the forward pass's, cancelling interior lag and improving tracking/lag at no smoothness cost — a mechanism the champion lineage never inherited. All downstream stages (widened robust SG with co-swept recency tilt, hysteresis snap with sign-flip logic, zero-phase polish) are kept exactly as validated. The graded-blend pre-convolution median snap from the last variant is also retained for its noise-reduction benefit. The only extra compute is one more O(n) Kalman pass, keeping efficiency ~1.0.
